subject: S12b rework: I take Alembic 0016 (down 0015, yours); one column on ink_layers
body: S12b was reopened. I need ink_layers.purged_before_ms (bigint not null default 0) and have claimed 0016 with down_revision '0015' (your 0015_notes_notebooks).
